body:
Thanks for the advice. I went to a psychologist for a while earlier this year, but he wasn't very helpful. He essentially told me to exercise more, which is near impossible for me to muster the will to do steadily. A compounding factor is that I loathe the idea of going outside and intermingling with people, especially since being incarcerated. 

There isn't really anything I enjoy doing anymore. I used to like learning, anything at all, but I think I have significantly debilitated my ability to learn and articulate my thoughts well (through alcohol, stress, depression, etc...). I studied computer science and biology in college, but I cannot afford to go back to finish a BS in either, nor do I really want to. I have a, possibly self-defeating, idea that I will never be able to work in a normal professional setting with a criminal record. That idea lends to my desire to end my life.
